text:
alex: Heads-up — saw a regression on KV-heavy inference after the recent kernel selection change. 8xA100, TP=2 PP=4, p95 up ~12% and throughput down ~8%. attaching perf link: <http://perf/fg/kv-reg-1769998881>

perf-bot: Auto summary: flamegraph attached. top contributors: all-reduce (38%), host<->device memcpy (18%), KV lookup (13%), compute stalls (12%). job=kv-infer-8gpu, commit=bb7f2e4

maria: Is KV currently replicated (DP) or sharded across GPUs? also what's batching config?

alex: KV is replicated (DP) right now — we replicated the small KV cache to avoid cross-rank lookups. batching: adaptive with max_delay_ms=5 and max_batch_tokens=2048.

tony: Replicating made sense earlier, but with the kernel change we pushed more data around. If all-reduce is 38% that smells like frequent cross-rank syncs + big memcopies when pipeline stages hand off.

sylvie: I ran a quick nvprof & cuprof sampling on the failing run, here's the snippet:
```
GPU 0: allReduce (sum)  12.4ms  -> 38% of kernel time
GPU 0: memcpy HtoD      5.8ms   -> 18% of kernel time
KV lookup kernels      4.2ms   -> 13% of kernel time
compute forward        10.1ms  -> 31% of kernel time
```
flamegraph: <http://perf/fg/1769998881> — you can see the all-reduce stacks correlate with pipeline boundaries.

maria: That suggests two levers to try: 1) shard KV by TP rank so KV lives local to the tensor-parallel group (reduce all-reduce scope), or 2) align KV shards with pipeline stages so stage-local KV avoids inter-stage transfers. both have tradeoffs for misses and memory balance.

tony: Exactly. Quick tradeoff notes: shard-by-TP (tp_local) reduces intra-layer all-reduce volume but increases complexity when tokens need KV across PP boundaries (we'd have to fetch across stages). shard-by-PP (pp_local) keeps stage-local caches small and avoids stage handoff, but TP all-reduces may still be larger. DP replicate is simplest but hits memcopy/all-reduce.

sylvie: Perf numbers from microbench (synthetic) I ran for 8GPUs, seq=2048, batch=8:
```
mode=dp_repl  -> p95 latency 314ms  throughput 260 tok/s  allreduce 40%
mode=tp_local -> p95 latency 278ms  throughput 290 tok/s  allreduce 22%  cross-stage fetch 7%
mode=pp_local -> p95 latency 292ms  throughput 280 tok/s  allreduce 30%  memcpy 12%
```
these are rough but consistent: tp_local looks promising.

maria: Can we get a realistic validation run with the real model and workloads? also try batching tweak: increase max_delay_ms to 10 to give batching more chance to amortize comms.

alex: I'll run three experiments: dp_repl (baseline), tp_local (shard by TP), and tp_local+batching(max_delay_ms=10). command I'll use:
```
./bench_kv_shard --mode tp_local --batch 8 --seq 2048 --model prod-v2 --kv-shard-strategy tp_local
```
I'll collect p50/p95/p99, throughput, and the perf flamegraphs.

infra-bot: Job queued: job_id=infra-4821, expected runtime ~45m, assigned to pool=dedicated-8xA100.

tony: If tp_local looks good, we should add a runtime option to prefer tp-local shards whenever TP groups exist and fall back to pp-local for constrained memory. Also add a metric for cross-stage KV fetches in the console.

sylvie: Agree. We should also add a lightweight profiling hook to count all-reduce bytes/sec per step so regression detection can alert earlier.

maria: Action items: (1) alex run the three experiments and drop flamegraphs + raw perf numbers in this thread, (2) sylvie add the all-reduce bytes/sec metric to perf pipeline, (3) tony prototype runtime option for tp_local fallback.

alex: will run now and post results in ~50m. tagging @maria @sylvie for follow-ups. :rocket:

perf-bot: Old regression alert linked: RG-2026-03-kv-02. If new runs show improvement, please update the regression ticket.

alex: quick note — if anyone wants to tweak the bench, test commands are available at: repo/tools/bench_kv_shard/README.md

maria: Thanks. please also include a sample of kv-hit-rate and cold-miss latency for each mode. that will help decide memory vs comm tradeoff.

alex: noted — will include hit-rate.
